thread:
sam: customer reported streaming hang in edge runtime when we rotate auth tokens. stream stops producing chunks and the ReadableStream errors out with `TypeError: InvalidStateError` after ~30s. they see duplicate billing events for the same request. repro below — urgent, escalated by CSM.

ria_support: thanks — can you paste minimal repro + SDK version? also region + edge runtime (vercel/deno/next)?

sam: pasted repro from customer (they're on vercel, node 18 edge runtime). SDK: @redwood/sdk-js v0.8.2 in their package, server-side uses v0.9.0 (suspect mismatch). code: 
```ts
// server (edge function)
import OpenAI from '@redwood/sdk-js';
export default async function handler(req) {
  const res = await OpenAI.streamCompletion({ model: 'gpt-4o', prompt: 'hello', stream: true });
  return new Response(res.body, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream' } });
}
```

sam: customer rotates bearer token every 25s (short-lived creds). they reuse the same fetch/response and attempt to pipe the ReadableStream to client. after token rotate the stream throws and closes. logs show SSE keep-alive events then `DOMException: The user aborted a request.` and `TypeError: InvalidStateError` in stack.

alex_eng: could be that the edge fetch+stream loses underlying socket when Authorization header changes on upstream. also v0.8 vs v0.9 changed how the SDK attaches the token (header vs signed url). can you include the exact error trace?

sam: logs: 
```
[2026-02-12T10:21:33.123Z] stream: received chunk id=1
[2026-02-12T10:21:58.456Z] auth: rotated token -> new token issued
[2026-02-12T10:21:59.002Z] stream: incoming chunk id=2
[2026-02-12T10:22:03.110Z] error: TypeError: InvalidStateError at ReadableStreamDefaultReader.read (native)
[2026-02-12T10:22:03.111Z] error: DOMException: The user aborted a request.
```

ria_support: interesting — they said billing double-charges: do they get two separate request ids? any duplicated request_id header returned?

sam: yes, header x-redwood-request-id changes after the rotate. Also see two usage webhook events within 5s for same client call id.

kevin_sre: pinging infra-bot to check connection resets on our edge fleet for that time window. infra-bot: can you surface connection/idle timeouts for region us-west-2 for 2026-02-12 10:21:30-10:22:10?

infra-bot: logs attached: 12 connections with TLS renegotiate events; 3 aborts where client closed socket mid-stream. no global rate limit. one instance had a TLS session rekey due to cert rotation (internal).

alex_eng: two hypotheses: 1) SDK v0.8 stream glue doesn't gracefully handle token rotation (it re-negotiates and spawns a second request, causing duplicate billing and abrupt close of original stream). 2) Edge runtime (vercel) closes stream when auth header changes on an active connection; SDK attempts transparent token swap by sending a follow-up request instead of renewing the underlying socket.

ria_support: requested steps for customer to test:
- pin SDK to v0.9.0 (where token attachment was moved server-side) or upgrade to latest canary
- change rotation to issue new connection (do not re-use same fetch) and see if duplicate billing stops
- set short repro with `Authorization` fixed value to isolate network vs token-swap behavior

sam: customer tried pin to v0.9.0 — streaming no longer errors, but latency increased ~120ms per chunk. they said it's acceptable for now but want root cause.

kevin_sre: follow-ups for engineering:
- reproduce on our vercel edge staging with short-lived token rotation (25s).
- instrument SDK stream to log when it attempts transparent token swap vs new request (add request_id correlation headers).
- check keepalive and socket re-use behavior in edge runtime when headers change.

alex_eng: I'll create a small repro in the infra/staging project. quick note: add `x-client-call-id` from customer to logs so we can correlate billing webhooks.

ria_support: telling customer: upgrade to v0.9.0 for immediate fix, we'll follow up with postmortem + root cause. :thumbsup:

sam: customer confirmed upgrade fixed immediate error. marking as escalated->resolved. will attach engineering action items to ticket.
